name: STL Youth Jobs: Discover You
what_you_do: A career exploration pathway for 14 and 15 year olds. You do career shadowing instead of a job. Workshops on job skills are optional.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 and 15 who live in St. Louis City or North St. Louis County.
pay_detail: Stipend paid after you finish the program. Amount not stated.
deadline_text: The pathways page still lists this pathway as open. The apply page says the summer 2026 application has closed. Summer 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the apply page. The program says it will contact you when the Summer 2027 application opens.
